note: Bank 1 is the release's own request text for the 37,682 items the paper scores, read from the release so the prompts are byte-identical to what DataDecide was evaluated on. Bank 2 is a disjoint item set from the same ten benchmarks, built with OLMES at the same pinned commit and the same five-shot task configs, with only the split changed and the item count capped at bank 1's count for that benchmark (an upper bound; MMLU validation holds about 1,531 items and the build summary records every shortfall). The zero-shot bank is bank 2's items with num_shots 0. Freeze the three request hashes in frozen.json before scoring any run.

verification.note: Bank-1 scores of a DataDecide run must reproduce the release's per-item margins; the two nats-per-byte thresholds match compute extra/config/tasks.json, and the correctness-agreement threshold is new here.
